why: Synthetic power-path fixture: J1 stands in for the USB-C connector of ref-esp32, whose TVS and USBLC6 ESD part this fixture does not instantiate; supply protection is not what it tests.

ARCHITECTURE 2.3 verdict 2: the 465 mA peak is a 100 % duty Wi-Fi TX rating, the average sets Tj (65-69 C). The fixture keeps the peak on purpose so the 142 C figure of that document is reproduced; tests/elec/test_budget.py asserts the finding is raised.
